label: negative
description: The custom modifier guarding setFee() is renamed onlyAdmin -> restricted, but its body (require(msg.sender == admin)) is identical. setFee() still carries the renamed modifier.
why_labeled: The access constraint is unchanged; only the modifier identifier differs. Resolving the modifier through its body AST rather than by name string shows the same msg.sender == admin check applies at commit N. A name-string detector would fire on the vanished onlyAdmin; a body-aware one recognizes the pure refactor and stays quiet. Exclusion 1.1.
